razor_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to sink_ba_ba1. Reality: It consistently rests on bathroom_shelf_ba1. Next time: Always check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first.

mug_priya: Pattern: I incorrectly assumed it moved to the bedroom nightstand or cupboard early in the day. Reality: It remained at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:21. It frequently shifts between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Next time: Check kitchen_table_k1 first in the morning; do not assume cupboard or bedroom movement without specific evidence.

glass_priya: Pattern: I over-corrected based on previous late-night data, assuming it stayed at nightstand_b1 or moved to cupboard_k1. Reality: At 22:29 on day 6, it was at kitchen_table_k1. It does not have a fixed late-night location; it can remain in the kitchen or move to the bedroom. Next time: Do not default to nightstand_b1 for late queries. Check kitchen_table_k1 first, then verify if it has moved to the bedroom.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I assumed it stayed at dish_rack_k1 based on a previous evening observation. Reality: At 22:28 on day 6, it was at kitchen_table_k1. It frequently returns to the table after being washed or used. Next time: Check kitchen_table_k1 first for evening queries; only check dish_rack_k1 if the table is empty.

General Note: Avoid rigid "late-night" location rules for glass_priya and water_bottle_priya. Both items frequently reside at kitchen_table_k1 even after 22:00. Previous notes suggesting they move to nightstands or dish racks are not reliable defaults for late-night queries. Prioritize kitchen_table_k1 for both items in the evening unless there is specific evidence of movement.
